```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
since=$(date -u -d '24 hours ago' '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
repos="iconbaypark2900/dcode-stack ..."
for r in $repos; do
  echo "=== $r ==="
  gh api "repos/$r/commits?since=${since}&per_page=50" --jq '.[] | "\(.commit.committer.date) \(.sha[0:7]) \(.commit.author.name): \([.commit.message | split("\n")[0]] | join(" "))"'
  echo "--- last commit overall ---"
  gh api "repos/$r/commits?per_page=1" --jq '.[0] | "\(.commit.committer.date) \(.sha[0:7]) \(.commit.author.name): \(.commit.message | split("\n")[0])"'
done
```
